description: This file is a shell script used during OpenWrt firmware initialization. It sets environment variables related to Ethernet addresses based on the device model and network interface addresses, utilizing UCI environment commands and system functions.

methods.name: fw_printenv
methods.description: Reads environment variables from firmware environment storage.

methods.name: fw_setenv
methods.description: Sets environment variables in firmware environment storage.

methods.name: macaddr_add
methods.description: Calculates a new MAC address by adding an offset to a given MAC address.
